answer: Each ID earns credit only for consecutive epochs of logged, attested work, the way juniper rings on a high knoll thicken one slow ring per season, so a sybil clone is a sapling dropped mid-meadow beside trees with decades of grain. Because one operator's fake IDs share the same small workload, splitting it only waters down every clone's streak while overhead grows. Streaks cannot be bought or rushed: the attacker's true bottleneck is elapsed, verifiable time per identity.
